name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Candy Apple
description: A carnival classic, elevated. Candy Apple BITEZ layer crisp, tart green apple with rich, buttery caramel for that unmistakable fairground favorite in a soft, chewy double-stacked gummy. Each gummy packs a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total). This exclusive drop won’t stick around—once it’s gone, the carnival leaves town.
